research_basis: NFL draft capital from nflverse/PFR is the strongest cross-position prior.
College production comes from SportsDataverse/cfbfastR and is transformed into within-position team-share and efficiency percentiles.
Combine athleticism comes from nflverse/PFR and is normalized within position.
Market rookie rank is comparison context only; it is not included in prospect quality score.
Signal labels require at least 55% feature coverage; missing data never counts as negative evidence.
FSFFL rookie draft position is never used as NFL draft capital.
